rationale: The discourse has stabilized into a clear impasse: investors/management want a rigorously quantified no-closure package or fallback to footprint reduction, while IG Metall and the Works Council hold firm red lines against closures and compulsory redundancies, with Lower Saxony aligned against closures. The last two rounds added expert thresholds but did not resolve the core incompatibility, so further open-ended rounds are unlikely to change positions without targeted intervention.
